limits: Single Linux/glibc host; three fresh processes per mode; warm OS caches; diagnostic ranges are not SLOs.
Paired full API runs alternated baseline and compact staging sequentially, without randomized order; ordering and host load can affect timing.
Initial-import RSS and full-workflow RSS with readers/retained views/repeated updates are different scopes.

Native and import-only Python profiles use the retained corpus with building 0 revision 2; the full API worker regenerates revision 0. Both shapes have 100 graphs and 334059 quads / 333008 union triples.

One exploratory optimized Python run and an interrupted test run used a repository-local older extension; those are excluded. The reported optimized Python runs use -I or an isolated test copy and the installed optimized wheel.
The baseline and compact paired runs record their actual installed extension paths.
Graph-changing publications still rewrite a complete file; explicit Graph input retains its indexed representation; repeated staged reads can rematerialize graphs.
Valgrind replaces the allocator; its timing/RSS are excluded from native/Python timing comparisons.
No allocator trim is enabled in production. Diagnostic trims happen after recording the import high-water mark.
